en.title: Shooting Distance and Target Format
en.excerpt: Standard guide to shooting distances and target face sizes for various archery divisions.
en.content:
Standard Shooting Distance

The shooting distance in archery depends greatly on the bow division and age group of the participant. The following are general standards that are often used in competitions in Indonesia:

  • Recurve Open (Senior): 70 Meters
  • Compound Open (Senior): 50 Meters
  • Standard Bow (General National): 40 or 50 Meters
  • Barebow: 20 or 50 Meters (Depending on event regulations)
  • Early Age Group (U-9/U-12): Starting from 5, 10, 15, to 20 Meters

Target Face Size

There are several target face sizes that are used based on the shooting distance:

  • Diameter 122 cm: Used for long distances (70m & 60m Recurve, as well as National Standard Bow).
  • Diameter 80 cm: Used for a distance of 50m (Compound and Barebow).
  • Diameter 60/40 cm: Used for close range or indoor matches.
  • 6-Ring Target: Especially for Compound elimination rounds, targets are often used that only display a 10 to 5 score zone.

Scoring Zones

The standard target face consists of 5 colors with 2 scoring rings each:

Yellow (9-10)
Red (7-8)
Blue (5-6)
Black (3-4)
White (1-2)

The highest score is 10 (center). If the arrow hits the line (line cutter), then the highest value it touches is taken.

Indoor vs Outdoor Format

Outdoor: The match is played in an open field. The main challenges for archers are the wind and sunlight factors. The distance used tends to be longer.

Indoor: The match is played indoors with a standard distance of 18 meters. Because there is no wind interference, the archer's accuracy is tested on the consistency of shots on smaller target faces (usually vertical 3-spots).

📏
Check Event Handbook
The committee has the authority to adjust the combination of distance and target size. Always read the official event announcement on the archeris.net platform before starting to practice.

id.title: Jarak Tembak dan Format Target
id.excerpt: Panduan standar jarak tembak dan ukuran target face untuk berbagai divisi panahan.
id.content:
Standar Jarak Tembak

Jarak tembak dalam panahan sangat bergantung pada divisi busur dan kelompok usia peserta. Berikut adalah standar umum yang sering digunakan dalam kompetisi di Indonesia:

  • Recurve Open (Senior): 70 Meter
  • Compound Open (Senior): 50 Meter
  • Standard Bow (Nasional Umum): 40 atau 50 Meter
  • Barebow: 20 atau 50 Meter (Tergantung regulasi event)
  • Kelompok Usia Dini (U-9/U-12): Mulai dari 5, 10, 15, hingga 20 Meter

Ukuran Target Face

Terdapat beberapa ukuran target face (permukaan target) yang digunakan berdasarkan jarak tembaknya:

  • Diameter 122 cm: Digunakan untuk jarak jauh (70m & 60m Recurve, serta Standard Bow Nasional).
  • Diameter 80 cm: Digunakan untuk jarak 50m (Compound dan Barebow).
  • Diameter 60/40 cm: Digunakan untuk jarak dekat atau pertandingan Indoor.
  • 6-Ring Target: Khusus babak eliminasi Compound, sering menggunakan target yang hanya menampilkan zona skor 10 hingga 5.

Zona Penilaian (Scoring Zones)

Target face standar terdiri dari 5 warna dengan masing-masing 2 ring penilaian:

Kuning (9-10)
Merah (7-8)
Biru (5-6)
Hitam (3-4)
Putih (1-2)

Nilai tertinggi adalah 10 (pusat). Jika anak panah mengenai garis (line cutter), maka diambil nilai tertinggi yang disentuhnya.

Format Indoor vs Outdoor

Outdoor: Pertandingan dilakukan di lapangan terbuka. Tantangan utama bagi pemanah adalah faktor angin dan cahaya matahari. Jarak yang digunakan cenderung lebih jauh.

Indoor: Pertandingan dilakukan di dalam ruangan dengan jarak standar 18 meter. Karena tidak ada gangguan angin, akurasi pemanah diuji pada konsistensi tembakan di target face yang lebih kecil (biasanya vertical 3-spot).

📏
Cek Handbook Event
Panitia memiliki wewenang untuk menyesuaikan kombinasi jarak dan ukuran target. Selalu baca pengumuman resmi event pada platform archeris.net sebelum mulai berlatih.
